summary: The r26 family validly refutes universal bounded-cardinality packet extraction, but it does not show high-cardinality bank aggregation is the only possible repair. The existing spectral-window ridge theorem pays the family continuously by <64 for n>16384 at delta=n^(-1/2). The preceding B11 r24 defect dichotomy also detects it through a fixed-scale STAR certificate q_i=(6n-4)delta^2=6-4/n. The true remaining B11 survivor is high-spectral-leverage balanced STAR/CROSS-2VOL receiving, not this diffuse family itself.
